title: Zion Tech Group - 7-Day Social Media Content Calendar

posts.hook: Most teams still spend 60% of their week on tasks AI could automate today.
posts.body: We've seen organizations cut manual processing time by 70% within the first quarter of implementing AI-driven workflows. The key? Start with high-volume, rule-based tasks — not everything at once.
posts.cta: What's the first process you'd automate if you had the resources?
